cards.front: On expectant care for a tubal ectopic, hCG has fallen from 900 to 600 IU/L. She now has shoulder-tip pain, pallor, HR 118 and BP 88/54. Alongside resuscitation, the definitive management is [___].
cards.context:
A falling hCG does not mean the tube is safe. New pain, shoulder-tip pain or haemodynamic change suggests rupture.

Resuscitate and proceed to urgent operation; expectant and medical options are only for a stable woman.

reference.title: Miscarriage, Recurrent Miscarriage and Ectopic Pregnancy (C-Gyn 38)

cards.front: With a modern transvaginal probe, polycystic ovarian morphology is defined as [___] or more follicles in at least one ovary.
cards.context:
Since the 2018 international guideline the count is 2–9 mm follicles in at least one ovary, up from Rotterdam's 12. Volume of 10 mL or more is used only when follicles cannot be counted.

In adults, a raised AMH can replace the scan.
